description: This PHP source file defines the class DetailedLeaveRequestMenuConfigurator, which implements menu configuration logic for leave request screens within the OrangeHRM system. It adjusts the screen based on the current request parameters, specifically handling the 'mode' query parameter to determine the appropriate view.

classes.name: DetailedLeaveRequestMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for leave request screens in OrangeHRM, switching views based on user request parameters.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the menu screen depending on the request mode, specifically handling 'my-leave' to display the user's leave list.
